page.layout: One page of text, one column of verse and prose, with a running head at the top; no margin notes; an ornamental rule and a decorated initial in the body.

main_text.p:
Cernens pusillum, spreuit, & impotens
Irae tumentis, dira saeuis
Vocibus atq; cruces minatus
Intentat hastam: sed Dauid occupat,
Fundaq; paruo vulnere stupeae
Magnum Gigantem funeratum
Exuuiis spoliat superbis.

Sed plura molli dicere barbito
Vetat tenella Musa potens Lyrae,
Quae gestit heroas Cothurno
Maeoniy resonare vatis.
main_text.head: EADEM DIE DVX GVI-SIVS INTERFECTVS QVA Rex Nauarrae natus.
main_text.p:
VAE te nascentem, Rex, magni conscia partus
Ostendit terris, prima, Nauarre dies,
Guisiadem ad stygias iussit penetrare paludes,
Auctior ut duplici luce at usque nota.
Nam te praesidium patriae dedit illa ruenti
Hic semper cuius pestis acerba fuit.

page.notes: Heading rule ornament and decorated initial O are not transcribed as text. Verse lines are reproduced as set; the initial letter of the first Latin stanza is a woodcut initial joined to "VAE". Some letterforms (long s, Greek-style ligatures such as "ꝗ" in "Quae") are read with caution.
